caption: The video showcases a close top-down view of two hands in dark ribbed sleeves working over a square gray metallic plate on a white surface. Each hand grips a short chain of glossy golden cubes, pressed together at a single corner joint while rotating relative to each other. The left segment, starting as a roughly horizontal stub, gradually reorients into a vertical column, while the right segment, initially a folded cluster, settles into a horizontal block meeting it at the top. The hands translate upward and inward, lifting the joined assembly higher in the frame toward the plate's edge. Small thumb and finger adjustments keep the corner steady as the angle between the segments opens into a clear right-angle shape. The L-shaped assembly stays held firmly between the hands, the corner joint remaining intact throughout the visible portion.
